newsitem.title: CANADA: CGI Group gets C$12 mln of contracts.
newsitem.headline: CGI Group gets C$12 mln of contracts.

text.p: CGI Group Inc said on Monday that it obtained six outsourcing contracts worth a total of C$12 million.

The contracts represent incremental revenues of about C$3 million annually for the next three years, with the remaining portion of the work taking place over the subsequent five years, the company said.
CGI said it expects that in fiscal 1996-97 outsourcing activities will generate 40 percent of its revenues and that market segment is forecast to grow by 23 percent a year to the year 2000.

Outsourcing is a practise through which an organization assigns the management of all or part of its information systems to a third party. CGI is a consulting firm in information technology, systems integration and outsourcing.
